solution.text:
\begin{align*}
(a+b+c)(ab+bc+ca) - abc &= \\ =
(a+b+c)(ab + c(a+b)) - abc &= \\ =
(a+b)ab + abc + (a+b)^2c + (a+b)c^2 - abc &= \\ =
(a+b)(ab + ac + bc + c^2) &= \\ =
(a+b)(a(b+c) + c(b+c))  &= \\ =
(a+b)(b+c)(c+a).&
\end{align*}
